summary: Cohen & Co Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a routine amendment to an existing credit facility. On June 18, 2026, its indirect subsidiary Cohen Company Securities LLC amended its Third Amended and Restated Loan Agreement with Byline Bank to update definitions, extend the maturity from June 2026 to June 2028, increase the tangible net worth covenant from $70M to $80M after March 2027, and add an excess net capital trigger of $30M under Rule 15c3-1. No acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation is involved; this is a standard credit agreement modification filed pursuant to Item 1.01. There are no deal terms or risk-arb angles to monitor.
